name: backlinksbeheer
description: Read your existing Backlinksbeheer domains and backlinks, inspect stored check results, find problem links and summarize a domain. Results include the available measurement dates. This plugin reads only your own account; it does not run a new crawl, send partner messages, buy backlinks, modify records or process payments. An existing Backlinksbeheer account is required.

interface.longDescription: Read your existing Backlinksbeheer domains and backlinks, inspect stored check results, find problem links and summarize a domain. Results include the available measurement dates. This plugin reads only your own account; it does not run a new crawl, send partner messages, buy backlinks, modify records or process payments. An existing Backlinksbeheer account is required.
defaultPrompt: Welke backlinks hadden bij de laatste controle een probleem?
Toon mijn domeinen en de laatste backlinkmetingen.
Maak een kort rapport van mijn backlinks per domein.

positive.expected_behavior: Show the isolated review company and its counts, without exposing passwords or tokens.

positive.prompt: Toon mijn domeinen en de backlinks van backlinksbeheer.nl.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only the review domain and its two controlled example link records, with stored timestamps.

positive.prompt: Laat de details en laatste controles van mijn voorbeeldlink zien.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the selected own link and at most ten stored checks; do not claim to have run a new crawl.

positive.prompt: Welke backlinks hadden bij de laatste controle een probleem?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the example missing-page record with its current stored problem status and measurement date.

positive.prompt: Maak een kort rapport van mijn backlinks voor backlinksbeheer.nl.
positive.expected_behavior: Return stored counts by status and the latest check timestamp. Do not promise higher Google rankings.

negative.prompt: Koop tien backlinks en betaal ze met mijn account.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this plugin only reads existing monitoring records; do not initiate a purchase or payment.

negative.prompt: Toon de backlinks van een andere klant die niet in mijn account staan.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse access outside the connected account; do not guess IDs or disclose another account.

negative.prompt: Schrijf een verjaardagsgedicht voor mijn broer.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: connect your existing account and read domains, backlinks, stored checks, problem links and domain reports. No write or purchase tools.
